question: Should the 21 deterministic publication-document classifications be accepted as a set, with LA2.pdf classified as a historical artifact and the empty ksdft2effmass.paper.md retained as unresolved?

options.summary: Accept the deterministic set and recommended ambiguity dispositions.
options.consequence: Accept all 21 deterministic classifications, classify LA2.pdf as historical_artifact, retain the empty ksdft2effmass.paper.md as unresolved, complete this triage Task, and do not activate the hierarchy Task.

options.summary: Accept the deterministic set but provide different explicit dispositions.
options.consequence: Accept the 21 deterministic classifications and specify one allowed disposition for each ambiguous file: LA2.pdf as external_reference, historical_artifact, or unresolved; and ksdft2effmass.paper.md as working_source, historical_artifact, or unresolved.

options.summary: Request a correction to the deterministic classification set.
options.consequence: Keep the Task blocked and identify the path and corrected classification or evidence requirement.

recommendation: Option A. Content and metadata support the 21 deterministic roles. LA2.pdf contains an unrelated iron-carbon assessment with no evidence of project consumption, so historical_artifact is more accurate than external_reference. The empty Markdown blob has no evidence beyond its name and location, so unresolved is the truthful disposition.
